prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless square PBR fur-detail texture tile for a realistic short-haired 3D desktop cat; a neutral detail/height and albedo-modulation bitmap, not an animal portrait.
Primary request: a uniformly dense field of very fine, short, off-white domestic-cat fur fibers viewed straight down at macro scale. Fibers lie mostly parallel from top to bottom, with a little natural waviness and slight length variation, closely overlapping without visible clumps. Natural feline fine-fiber structure, soft individual strands, restrained mid-frequency detail.
Composition: edge-to-edge square material texture, orthographic and flat, seamless repeating edges on both axes, consistent scale and density across the entire tile.
Lighting: completely even diffuse illumination, no directional shading, no highlights, no vignette, no cast shadows or large dark patches; suitable for deriving a subtle height normal and modulating a PBR coat.
Palette: neutral off-white and pale gray only, low-to-moderate local contrast; no warm yellow staining or colored spots.
Constraints: only fine fur material fills the entire image; no animal face, body shape, eyes, paws, skin, bald areas, background, room, folds, fabric weave, shaggy tufts, long hair, dramatic lighting, text, numbers, watermark, or logo. Do not depict a photographed pelt with baked broad shadows. Do not add a border.
intended_use: Neutral short-cat-fur albedo modulation and height-derived tangent normal detail in owned Unreal materials.

review.visual: Fine off-white and pale-gray fur fibers; no face, background, text or logo. Mostly parallel fibers with gentle waviness and low broad illumination variation.
review.shader_seam_handling: Actual Unreal texture uses mirror addressing, trilinear filtering and generated SimpleAverage mips; source pixels remain unchanged.

rights_note: Generated without reference images or downloaded source artwork. This record identifies the AI-generated origin; it does not alter the CC BY-NC terms on the existing cat model or source atlas.

unreal_material_update.ab_test: Set FineFurAlbedoStrength and FineFurNormalStrength to 0 for baseline; no native code change required.

preservation.OriginalCoatWeight_1: Original source albedo and original normal path retained; generated modulation disabled
preservation.nose_mouth_iris: Original atlas protection and separate iris material retained

limits: The generated source image is not an exactly periodic bitmap; mirror addressing removes abrupt wrap seams at the shader sampler.
Frequency is estimated in the source atlas UVs; the source model has nonuniform UV distortion and there is no per-fiber anatomical growth calibration.
This adds filtered surface fiber detail and shallow normal variation, not strand Groom, simulation or additional silhouette geometry.
Actual 512px movement and A/B review must judge shimmer, repeated patterns and realism before acceptance.
